description: Live predicted arrivals at one or more TriMet stops in Portland — bus, MAX light rail, WES and Streetcar — with scheduled vs estimated time, route, headsign and vehicle. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH and over any timetable: these are TriMet's own realtime predictions. Get stop ids from trimet_stops_near.

_apiKey.description: TriMet appID. Free from https://developer.trimet.org/appid/registration/. Omit if the operator has configured a platform key.

stop_ids.description: One or more TriMet stop ids, comma-separated (e.g. "7646" or "7646,7647").

name: trimet_arrivals
title: Trimet Arrivals
